strongest_angle: GitHub Design has open-sourced Replica under the MIT license as an AI-powered prototyping tool that utilizes a team's own components and design systems.

key_facts.fact: GitHub Design has open-sourced Replica, an AI-powered prototyping tool created to help product teams turn ideas into interactive prototypes.
Nvdium reported that GitHub open-sourced Replica under the MIT license for building interactive prototypes in the Copilot app.
DigIntoAI reported on October 28, 2026, that GitHub Design open-sourced Replica under the MIT license to use existing components and documentation.
